title: aidd standard list --json
description: The choices the domain packs and practice skills leave open, each with aidd's default answer, and aidd's library of opinionated standards that fill them. A new optional key may be added in a minor release; a renamed or removed key bumps `schema_version`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

open_choices.description: Every open choice, by its `<pack>:<choice>` reference.

pack.description: The domain pack or practice skill that leaves the choice open.

default_answer.description: aidd's default answer, in words, until a standard fills the choice.

filled_by.description: The library standards that fill it, by id.

default_by_ecosystem.description: aidd's default library standard for the choice, by ecosystem, where the library holds several options.

tool.description: The tool it chooses, or null for none.

checked_version.description: The tool's version read on the `checked` day.

checked.description: The day the version or the claim was read at its source.

status.description: Whether a project may add it.

default.description: True when it is aidd's default for its choice and ecosystem.

trust.description: Who checked it: an agent, or a person's review.

policy.description: The company's mark from `standards_policy`: required, excluded, replaced by another, or empty.

added.description: True when this repository holds a copy.
